notes: A supervision op, not a straight kill, and reading it as one would be wrong: a Soldier engages a Trained Crab and you have to let him build focus first -- the log runs "The soldier seems unfocused..." to "has begun training harder!" to "is fighting with vigor!" -- and only then may the crab be killed. If he never gains focus the op is lost. The Soldier is an ally to keep alive, never a target, so he is not in mobs; the focus state is a log message and nothing the addon can observe, hence the latent_unmodelled flag. The crab is named and singular, so it is recorded. Entry is by the "Allied Ensign" at East Ronfaure (S) (G-5), stated outright, so this ladder carries real positions. Bullet [2]'s sub-bullets are a walking route and a stale party-size note; bullet [4]'s sub-bullets are the log lines; the Notes section is tactics and the Related Links section is a testimonials link. Header Time "30 minutes" is the battlefield limit and Campaign Rank is "Bronze Ribbon of Service"; neither has a schema field and neither is a character level, so gates.level stays null against a header Level of "Any".
